  • Method Details

    • from

      public static DispenserTarget from(net.minecraft.core.dispenser.BlockSource source)
      Derives the target geometry for a dispenser activation: the block directly in front along the dispenser's facing, the face pointing back at the dispenser, a centered BlockHitResult on that face, and a ProtectionContext acting as the level's stable automation player. The automation player is moved to the dispenser's center, facing outward, so interactions it performs, and the sounds they play from the player's position, originate at the dispenser.
      Parameters:
      source - the activating dispenser
      Returns:
      the derived target geometry and action context

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
